claim: The measured cost of an over-provisioned environment image is startup latency, not just storage: larger dependency payloads directly and measurably lengthen cold-start initialization on serverless-style sandbox platforms. Current practice's fix is not image shrinking alone but pre-warmed memory/filesystem snapshotting that captures already-imported libraries so later cold starts skip re-importing them entirely -- a caching strategy distinct from, and beyond, plain OCI layer caching.
query: agent sandbox image caching cold start time large image size cost 2026
read: A snapshot captures already-loaded NumPy, PyArrow, and framework code, removing import time from every cold start that follows.
snippet: Dependency size has a measurable effect on cold start latency on many serverless platforms. Larger payloads drive longer initialization windows.
title: Fix Cold Start Latency in AI Sandboxes: Techniques
topic: Measured cost of an over-provisioned environment image: dependency payload size directly lengthens cold-start latency; production fix is snapshot-based reuse, not just smaller images

claim: A catalogue of current agent-facing specs (AGENTS.md, agent.md, Spec Kit, 12-Factor Agents, 12-Factor AgentOps, Dynamic Workflows) covers development-environment setup instructions, testing protocols, architecture/workflow patterns, and production operations (reproducibility, logging, versioning) -- but none of them is a machine-consumable declaration of the environment's actual contents (base image, toolchain, dependency versions) the way the OCI Image Spec declares a container image. The sandbox-vs-environment split this repo is missing has no single named standard yet; only fragmented point solutions exist (Dockerfile/devcontainer.json, Nix flakes, Kubernetes SandboxTemplate, each independently found in this pass).

claim: The OCI homepage itself (not a record's paraphrase) describes the Runtime Specification's job as governing how a filesystem bundle unpacked from an OCI Image gets run by an OCI Runtime; it does not name runc or any other implementation anywhere on this page.
query: OCI Runtime Specification scope filesystem bundle OCI Runtime
read: The Runtime Specification outlines how to run a “filesystem bundle” that is unpacked on disk. At a high-level an OCI implementation would download an OCI Image then unpack that image into an OCI Runtime filesystem bundle. At this point the OCI Runtime Bundle would be run by an OCI Runtime.
